chapters.title: Postorder height with a nonlocal best
chapters.code:
def diameter(root):
    best = 0

    def height(node):
        nonlocal best
        if node is None:
            return 0
        left = height(node.left)
        right = height(node.right)
        best = max(best, left + right)   # path bending here, in edges
        return 1 + max(left, right)      # what the parent actually needs

    height(root)
    return best

return 1 + max(left, right) — height returns 2 to height (what the parent actually needs)

return 1 + max(left, right) — height returns 1 to height (what the parent actually needs)
best = max(best, left + right) — best = 3; node moves to (1); left = 2; right = 1 (path bending here, in edges)
return 1 + max(left, right) — height returns 3 to diameter (what the parent actually needs)
